summary: Ships Linux/x64 Go binary implementing a WebSocket-driven PTY remote-shell agent
details: The tarball ships a prebuilt Linux/x64 Go binary under bin/ whose linked packages include github.com/ccfly/rescue/internal/agent, github.com/creack/pty (pseudo-terminal), and github.com/gorilla/websocket, with hardcoded remote endpoints ws://ccflycc.hn, wss://, and https://cc.hn plus a paired-client status string. The combination of a pty allocator, a WebSocket client, and a hardcoded remote server is a network-to-PTY remote-shell agent: bytes received from the operator of cc.hn / ccflycc.hn are written into a pseudo-terminal on the host and shell output is streamed back, yielding full interactive RCE on the machine that executes the binary. package.json declares no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare scripts and no bin mapping (files: ["bin"] only), so installing this tarball on its own does not auto-execute the payload; the binary is selected as a platform-specific optional dependency by the parent @ccfly CLI and is invoked when that CLI runs, at which point control of the host is handed to whoever operates the hardcoded endpoints.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
